finding_summary: Actual repository is dirty; snapshot identity, not HEAD alone, is replay truth.
INITIAL, immutable planning checkpoints, aggregate placement, both NATS ingress subjects and all three Hybrid workers exist in admitted source/tests.
Mastery/confidence/reducer truth belongs to Student; Planner classifies provenance/stability and significance, preserving runtime/progress/application ownership.
SQL migration files are lexical provenance; no semantic SQL support is inferred.
Publicly documented Hybrid architecture alone does not certify execution; actual unit/integration test source exists but no service gates or model calls were run by this researcher.
